// frontend/src/components/Reports/reportTemplatesConfig.js

export const REPORT_TEMPLATES = [

    id: 'executive_summary',
    name: 'Executive & Donor Summary',
    badge: 'Donors & Board',
    badgeColor: '#2E2C6E',
    badgeBg: '#EEF0F8',
    description: 'High-level strategic summary with core program KPIs, beneficiary reach, demographic distribution, and key achievements.',
    defaultTitle: 'Executive & Donor Program Summary',
    defaultSubtitle: 'Strategic Overview of Interventions, Reach & Beneficiary Outcomes',

    name: 'M&E Comprehensive Progress',

  {
    id: 'community_outreach_training',
    name: 'Community Outreach & Training',
